answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the juniper of a task receipt, and the onyx is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
